blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image given a reference image and a modification text. Although recent approaches leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown significant progress, we argue that the MLLM's compositional understanding remains underutilized. This stems from directly mapping composed queries into a retrieval embedding via contrastive supervision alone, without explicitly resolving the intended visual modifications. In this work, we introduce Factorized MLLM Embeddings (FactEmbed), which decouples compositional query comprehension from building discriminative embeddings. Rather than directly projecting the composed query into a single embedding without internal reasoning, FactEmbed employs a set of factorized latents that simulate the intended visual modifications via an intermediate target imagination objective. This process encourages the latents to ground into target semantics before forming discriminative representations for retrieval. Subsequently, to propagate these factorized representations throughout the model for retrieval, we optimize a factor-level contrastive loss while distilling the decomposed representations into a deeper attention layer of the MLLM. Finally, for efficient inference, we retain the [EOS] token to establish a global-level embedding on top of these factorized latents, while we exploit the mean-pooled factorized latents to rerank a short candidate list at negligible cost, as both are produced by the same forward pass. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FactEmbed outperforms prior works across CIR benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 编成的图像检索(CIR)旨在获取一个给定的参考图像和修改文本的目标图像. 虽然最近利用多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)的办法已显示出重大的进展,但我们争辩说,MLLM的构成理解仍然没有得到充分利用。 这源于直接将所构成的查询映射成仅通过对比性监督而嵌入的检索,而没有明确解决预期的视觉修改。 在这项工作中,我们引入了因果化的 MLLM 嵌入(FactEmbed),它将构象查询理解与构建歧视性嵌入脱钩. FactEmbed不直接将所构成的查询投射成一个没有内部推理的单一嵌入,而是使用一套因子化的潜伏物,通过中间目标想象目标模拟预期的视觉修改. 这一过程鼓励潜伏者在形成供检索的歧视性表述之前,进入目标语义。 随后,为了在整个模型中传播这些因子化的表示,我们优化了因子级的对比性损失,同时将分解的表示分解成MLLM更深的注意力层. 最后,为了有效推论,我们保留了一种[EOS]标志,以便在这些因素化的潜质之上建立一个全球层次的嵌入物,同时我们利用平均集合的因素化潜质,以可忽略不计的代价重新排列一个简短的候选名单,因为两者都是通过同样的前进通道产生的。 广泛的评价表明,FactEbed在以往工作上超越了CIR基准。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image from a gallery using a composed query, consisting of a reference image and a modification text [ 70 ] .
CIR allows users to express their search intent through relative descriptions: they may provide an image and specify how the desired result should differ from it.
This paradigm is appealing when users can recognize a desired image by its visual relation to a reference, but cannot easily describe the target itself.
blocks.zh:
编成的图像检索(CIR)旨在利用一个编成的查询从画廊中获取一个目标图像,包括一个参考图像和一个修改文本[70].
CIR允许用户通过相对描述来表达他们的搜索意图:他们可以提供图像,并具体说明期望的结果应该如何与其不同.
这种范式在用户可以通过其与参考物的视觉关系来识别所期望的图像时具有吸引力,但不能轻易描述目标本身.

blocks.en:
Recently, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have emerged as a powerful foundation for CIR, owing to their ability to deeply fuse visual and linguistic information within a unified autoregressive representation space [ 76 , 22 ] .
A common strategy is to finetune an MLLM contrastively by compressing the multimodal query and the target image into a single embedding, typically obtained from the final [EOS] token, and directly optimizing their similarity [ 65 , 48 , 79 , 76 ] .
Despite its effectiveness, this formulation exposes a key limitation: forcing a direct mapping onto a single embedding provides no explicit signal for the MLLM to exploit its compositional understanding capability to resolve the requested edit before forming a discriminative embedding.
blocks.zh:
最近,多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)已成为CIR的强大基础,因为它们能够在统一的自递性代表空间内将视觉和语言信息深度融合[76,22].
一个共同的策略是通过将多式联运查询和目标图像压缩成一个单一嵌入式,通常从最终[EOS]令牌获得,直接优化其相似性[65,48,79,76],从而对MLLM进行对比性微调.
尽管其有效性,但这种配方暴露出一个关键限制:强迫直接映射到一个单一嵌入物上,并不能为MLLM提供明确信号,使其在形成歧视嵌入物之前利用其组成理解能力来解决请求的编辑.

blocks.en:
To overcome this, we aim to decouple query comprehension from discriminative embedding learning, allowing the model to first simulate the requested edit, i.e . , imagine the target, and then build its retrieval embedding upon the imagined target. We present FactEmbed, which realizes this intermediate step through a compact set of factorized latents that parse the query before producing the final embedding.
These factorized latents are prepended to the [EOS] token in the input sequence, serving as information bottlenecks that decompose fused multimodal queries into factor-level components.
This explicit decomposition enables FactEmbed to isolate specific visual attributes and distinguish the factors the text modifies from those it preserves, in contrast to direct contrastive mapping which only implicitly infers the modified embedding.
To encourage each latent to capture different details in the target image, we adopt a target imagination objective parameterized by a lightweight decoder over these latents.
Given a coarse layout prior of the target, the latents are trained to imagine the residual fine-grained factors that the prior cannot explain.
Constraining reconstruction through these bottlenecks forces the latents to cluster semantically coherent target factors to maximize the coverage.
This provides structural supervision without requiring explicit reasoning traces or dense annotations, thereby allowing the model to implicitly simulate the specified edit.
blocks.zh:
为了克服这一点,我们的目标是将查询理解与歧视性嵌入学习脱钩,让模型首先模拟请求的编辑,即想象目标,然后将其检索嵌入想象中的目标上. 我们介绍FactEmbed,它通过一套紧凑的元素化潜质来意识到这一中间步骤,这些潜质在产生最终嵌入之前对查询进行了解析.
这些因子化的潜在物被准备到输入序列中的[EOS]符号上,成为信息瓶颈,将熔化的多式联运查询分解成因子级组件.
这种明显的分解使得FactEmbed能够孤立特定视觉属性,并区分文字修改后的因素和它所保存的因素,与直接对比的映射形成对比,而直接对比的映射只是隐含地推断了修改后的嵌入.
为了鼓励每个潜伏者捕捉目标图像中不同的细节,我们采用了一个目标想象客观参数,通过一个轻量级解码器在这些潜伏物上进行参数化.
鉴于目标之前的布局粗糙,潜伏体被训练成可以想象残余的精细因素,而前人无法解释这些因素.
通过这些瓶颈制约重建工作,迫使潜在因素将整体一致的目标因素组合起来,以最大限度地扩大覆盖面。
这提供了结构监督,而不需要明确的推理痕迹或密集的说明,从而允许模型隐含地模拟指定的编辑.

blocks.en:
Reconstruction alone, however, shapes the latents generatively without ensuring their utility for retrieval: paired query and target could be faithfully decomposed yet embedded in incompatible coordinate spaces.
We address this by adapting target imagination for retrieval in two ways.
First, we apply a factor-level InfoNCE objective directly on the factorized latents, ensuring that the decomposed factors are aligned for retrieval rather than only for reconstruction.
Second, we distill the decoder’s factorized representation into the attention maps of the latents at a deeper layer, transferring the fine-grained decomposition from the auxiliary head into the backbone layers accessed during retrieval.
blocks.zh:
然而,光是重建就能够使潜在物基因化,而不能确保它们用于检索:对质的查询和目标可以忠实地分解,但嵌入不兼容的坐标空间。
我们通过两种方式调整目标想象来解决这个问题。
首先,我们直接将一个要素级的InfoNCE目标应用于因子化的潜伏物,确保分解的因子对齐用于回收,而不仅仅是重建.
其次,我们把解码器的因子化的表示分解成更深层的潜伏物的注意图,把细细的分解从辅助头部转移到在检索时进入的骨干层。

blocks.en:
Lastly, we assign complementary roles to the two outputs produced in a single forward pass.
Positioned prior to the [EOS] , the factorized latents allow [EOS] to integrate the decomposed factors into a global retrieval embedding, while [EOS] is optimized as a single retrieval embedding for efficient retrieval.
Yet, as fine-grained information is inevitably diluted when aggregating multiple factors into a single discriminative embedding, we rerank a short candidate list retrieved by [EOS] using the mean-pooled latents.
This complementary structure allows FactEmbed to achieve fast global recall via single [EOS] token while precision is significantly boosted by recovering fine-grained factor evidence during reranking.
Because both representations originate from a single forward pass and the mean-pooled latent adds only one vector per image, this design complements the global embedding with factor-level evidence without additional encoding or heavy storage overhead.
Combined with our MLLM data augmentation, FactEmbed achieves state-of-the-art results on CIR benchmarks, outperforming both CIR methods and general-purpose embedding models.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们把互补作用分配给以单一前进方向实现的两项产出。
定位在[EOS]之前,因子化的潜伏物允许[EOS]将分解的因子整合到全局检索嵌入中,而[EOS]则被优化为单一检索嵌入,以便高效检索.
然而,由于精细信息在将多种因素汇总成单一的歧视性嵌入时不可避免地被稀释,我们重新排列了[欧洲OS]利用平均集合潜伏物检索的短名单。
这种互补结构允许 FactEmbed通过单一[EOS]符号实现快速的全球召回,而精准度则在重新排位时通过回收精细的因子证据而大大提升.
由于这两种表示都来源于单一的前进通道,而平均集合潜伏只增加每个图像一个矢量,因此这一设计以要素级证据补充全球嵌入,而无需额外的编码或大量存储管理费.
FactEmbed结合我们的MLLM数据扩充,在CIR基准上取得了最先进的成果,在CIR方法和通用嵌入模型上都表现优异.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Composed Image Retrieval. CIR aims to retrieve a target image from a gallery given a reference image with a modification text that states how the desired result should differ from it [ 70 , 49 , 51 , 12 ] .
Earlier works [ 2 , 70 , 8 , 73 , 72 , 23 ] attempted to resolve representational conflict by performing the composition inside CLIP [ 58 ] or BLIP [ 34 , 33 ] embeddings.
Then, since collecting high-precision annotations for CIR incurs significant cost [ 78 , 18 ] , two parallel lines of research have been actively explored: learning with noisy CIR annotations [ 6 ] and zero-shot approaches [ 59 ] .
While the former stream attempted to mitigate the impact of noisy annotations by leveraging loss dynamics [ 37 ] , similarity curves [ 29 ] , MLLM-constructed anchor set [ 10 ] , or unlearning process [ 41 ] , zero-shot approaches aim to bypass the high cost of collecting annotated triplets [ 21 , 3 , 13 , 26 , 39 , 66 ] .
Notably, recent zero-shot methods also anticipate the target, either by generating a proxy image [ 39 ] or by leveraging a world model [ 66 ] ; in contrast, our imagination is embedded within the embedding model itself, requiring neither a generative model nor an additional inference pass.
blocks.zh:
编译图像检索. CIR旨在从一个提供参考图像的画廊中取回目标图像,并附有修改文本,说明预期结果应如何与其不同[70、49、51、12]。
早先的作品[2, 70, 8, 73, 72, 23]试图通过在CLIP [58] 或BLIP [34, 33] 嵌入式内置来解决代表性冲突.
之后,由于收集CIR的高精度说明会产生巨大的成本[78,18],因此积极探索了两条平行的研究线:用吵闹的CIR说明[6]和零镜头方法学习[59].
前者试图通过利用损失动态[37]、相似性曲线[29]、MLLM构建的锚定[10]或未学习过程[41]来减轻噪音说明的影响,但零射法旨在绕过收集附加说明的三重体的高昂成本[21、3、13、26、39、66]。
值得注意的是,最近的零射法也通过生成代理图像[39]或利用世界模型[66]来预测目标;相反,我们的想象力嵌入嵌入模型本身,不需要基因模型或额外的推论传承.

blocks.en:
More recently, LLMs and MLLMs have been widely adopted in CIR owing to their strong comprehension capabilities.
CIR-LVLM [ 65 ] adapted a local MLLM for CIR by introducing intent-aware instructions with learnable soft prompts, while ReCALL [ 76 ] proposed MLLM-based triplet augmentation strategy by diagnosing the blind spots of adapted MLLM retriever.
To further exploit the comprehension capability of LLMs, CCIN [ 67 ] and FIRE-CIR [ 11 ] incorporated an external LLM at query time to decompose the query at the attribute level, which, however, incurs substantial inference overhead, with FIRE-CIR further requiring verification linear in the number of candidates.
Thus, in this work, we adapt a local MLLM to exploit its inherent comprehension capability; whereas prior MLLM-based methods [ 65 , 76 ] directly map the composed query onto a single embedding, we encourage the model to decompose the query within a single forward pass and build the retrieval embedding on top of the decomposed factors.
blocks.zh:
最近,由于LLM和MLLM具有很强的理解能力,它们在CIR中得到广泛采用.
CIR-LVLM [65] 为CIR改编了本地的MLLM,引入了意識指示,带有可学习的软提示,而ReCALL [76]则提出了基于MLLM的三重增强策略,通过诊断适应性MLLM检索器的盲点.
为了进一步利用LLMs的理解能力,CCIN[67]和FIRE-CIR[11]在查询时采用了外部LLM,以在属性一级分解查询,但需要大量推断,FIRE-CIR进一步要求核实候选人人数的线性。
因此,在这项工作中,我们调整了本地的MLLM,以利用其固有的理解能力;而以前的基于MLLM的方法[65,76]直接将所构成的查询映射到单一嵌入,我们鼓励该模型在单个前传中分解查询,并将检索嵌入在分解因素之上.

blocks.en:
Multimodal Retrieval with MLLMs. MLLM embeddings are being extensively studied in multimodal retrieval where complex comprehension is required [ 52 , 80 , 35 ] .
VLM2Vec [ 25 ] initially used the last hidden state of the [EOS] token of a causal MLLM.
Yet, as [EOS] is not designed to generate embeddings, different methods are being studied, e.g. , mean-pooling [ 31 , 69 , 38 ] and multi-vector embeddings [ 44 , 27 , 9 ] .
Also, integrating computation via explicit reasoning [ 16 ] , latent rollouts [ 17 ] , or reinforcement-learned generative embeddings [ 30 ] is another prominent line of research.
Our work resembles the stream of appending a small bank of learned tokens whose hidden states become the representation [ 75 , 64 ] . None of these works, however, constrains what an individual token should represent.
In contrast, we leverage target reconstruction as a structural supervisory signal, forcing each factorized latent to ground and specialize in spatially coherent regions of the target scene.
blocks.zh:
与 MLLMs 进行多式联运检索。 在需要复杂理解的多式联运检索中,正在广泛研究MLLM嵌入法[52、80、35]。
VLM2Vec [25] 最初使用一个因果MLLM的[EOS]符号的最后一个隐藏状态.
然而,由于[EOS]不是用来生成嵌入的,因此正在研究不同的方法,例如平均集合[31,69,38]和多载体嵌入[44,27,9].
此外,通过明确的推理[16]、潜在的推展[17]或强化-吸取的基因嵌入[30]来综合计算是另一条突出的研究线。
我们的作品类似于一串 附属于一小串有学问的代币 其隐藏状态变成了代表[75,64]。 但是,这些作品都没有限制个人的象征。
与此相反,我们利用目标重建作为一种结构监督信号,迫使每个因素化的潜伏在地面,并专门研究目标场景的空间连贯区域。

blocks.en:
Figure 1 : Overview of FactEmbed. Given a composed query and a target image, FactEmbed introduces a compact set of learnable factorized latents into the input sequence.
To enforce structured factorization without requiring dense annotations, we attach a decoder to an intermediate MLLM layer, which utilizes these latents as an information bottleneck to reconstruct target patch features via a target imagination objective.
In addition, we apply a factor-level InfoNCE to the resulting latents { u k } k = 1 K \{u_{k}\}_{k=1}^{K} to leverage the decomposed factors for retrieval, while global-level embedding z z is trained with the instance-level InfoNCE objective.
blocks.zh:
图1: FactEmbed概览。 FactEmbed鉴于一个有组成的查询和目标图像,在输入序列中引入了一套精密的可学习因素化潜质。
为了在不需要密集说明的情况下实施结构化的保理化,我们在中间的MLLM层上加了一个解码器,它利用这些潜在物作为信息瓶颈,通过目标想象目标重建目标补丁特征.
此外,我们对产生的潜伏值 { u k} k = 1 K 使用因子级 InfoNCE X\{u_{k}\}_{k=k=1}^{K}利用分解因子进行检索,而Global级嵌入z z则通过实例级的InfoNCE目标训练.

blocks.en:
Compact Latent Representations. Representing an input as a small set of latents has been studied extensively across fields.
Retrievers used it for late interaction [ 32 , 53 , 42 , 36 ] , Perceiver [ 20 , 19 ] exploited latents to decouple compute from input size, DETR [ 4 ] used them as object queries to perform object detection, and slot attention [ 50 , 60 , 61 ] utilized slots to decompose the scene into object-wise regions by normalizing the attention across latents.
FactEmbed adopts the same competitive normalization in its decoder to induce factor-level specialization, but keeps the MLLM’s forward pass intact, thereby preserving kernel optimizations such as FlashAttention [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh:
近卫代表 各领域广泛研究了作为少量潜在因素的投入。
Retrievers将其用于后期交互[32,53,42,36],Perceiver [20,19] 利用潜伏物来解析输入大小的计算,DETR [4] 将其用作对象查询以进行对象检测,时位注意 [50,60,61] 利用插槽将场景分解为对象区域,使整个潜伏物的注意力正常化.
FactEmbed在其解码器中采用了同样的竞争性正常化,以诱导要素级的专业化,但保持MLLM的前进通道完好无损,从而保持内核优化,如FlashAttention [7].

blocks.en: 3 FactEmbed: Factorized MLLM Embeddings
blocks.zh: 3 FactEmbed:因数化的 MLLM 嵌入

blocks.en:
Task. Given a query q = ( I r , T ) q=(I_{r},T) consisting of a reference image I r I_{r} and a modification text T T , the goal of Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) is to retrieve the target image t = I t t=I_{t} that depicts the reference after the described modification.
The task is intrinsically compositional: the model must decide which visual factors of I r I_{r} the text modifies ( e.g . , “replace the logo on the shirt”) and which it must preserve ( e.g . , the rest of the shirt and the background), then express the result of that edit as a retrievable representation.
blocks.zh:
任务 鉴于一个查询 q = (I r, T ) q = (I_{r}, T ) 包含一个参考图像 I r r_{r)和一个修改文本 T T , 编译图像检索(CIR)的目标是检索目标图像 t = I t = I_{t),描述描述描述修改后的引用.
任务本质上是构成性的:模型必须决定文本中哪些视觉因素可以修改(例如“更换衬衫上的标志”),以及它必须保留哪些内容(例如衬衫的其余部分和背景),然后将编辑的结果作为可检索的表示。

blocks.en:
Overview. As shown in Fig. 1 , FactEmbed adapts an MLLM to produce CIR embeddings, utilizing a shared backbone to encode both the multimodal query and the target image.
Rather than mapping the input directly to a single vector, we first introduce K K learnable factorized latents into the multimodal input, on top of which the [EOS] embedding is formed.
This provides the model with the capacity to represent the complex query as a structured set of compositional components.
To ground these latents in the visual content of the target image, we train them to reconstruct the target’s patch features beyond a coarse layout prior, a process we refer to as target imagination.
We perform this reconstruction by attaching a lightweight decoder at an intermediate layer of the MLLM, which allows the deeper layers to transform the decomposed factors into discriminative representations for retrieval.
For retrieval training, we apply InfoNCE [ 5 ] at two levels: a factor-level loss encourages the factorized latents to contribute to retrieval by matching the query and target latents via optimal transport, while an instance-level loss optimizes the global embedding.
In this way, the imagined decomposition propagates fine-grained evidence into a compact embedding that remains efficient for retrieval.
blocks.zh:
概览. 如图1所示,FactEmbed对一个MLLLM进行调整,以生产CIR嵌入,利用共享主干编码多式联运查询和目标图像.
我们不是将输入直接映射到单一向量上,而是首先将K K 的可学习因素化潜质引入到多式联运输入中,上面是[EOS]嵌入体.
这为模型提供了将复杂的查询作为结构化的一组组成成分来表示的能力.
为了在目标图像的视觉内容中挖掘这些潜质,我们训练他们重建目标补丁的特性,超越粗糙的布局,我们称之为目标想象的过程。
我们通过在MLLM的中间层加装一个轻量级解码器来进行这种重建,这使得更深层能够将分解因素转化为用于检索的歧视性表示.
对于检索培训,我们在两个层面应用InfoNCE[5]:因子级损失鼓励因子级潜在物通过优化运输方式匹配查询和目标潜在物,从而对检索作出贡献,而实例级损失则优化了全球嵌入。
这样,想象中的分解将精细的纹理证据传播到一种仍能有效检索的紧凑嵌入物中.

blocks.en: 3.1 Factorized Latents with Target Imagination
blocks.zh: 3.1 带有目标想象的因数化梯队

blocks.en:
Motivation. CIR requires modifying specific visual concepts given text instructions ( e.g. , replacing an item).
However, directly mapping a composed query to a global embedding in an MLLM provides no explicit mechanism for disentangling the visual attributes to be modified from those that should remain invariant.
To overcome this, we introduce a compact set of factorized latents whose explicit job is to parse the scene into structured factors.
By decomposing the representation, these latents are designed to give the model room to express the instructed modification on the relevant factors without distorting the others.
blocks.zh:
动静. CIR要求修改给定文本指示的特定视觉概念(例如替换一个项目).
然而,直接绘制一个集成的查询,将一个全局嵌入到一个MLLM中,没有为将修改的视觉属性与那些应该保持不变的视觉属性区分开来提供明确的机制。
为了克服这种情况,我们引入了一套紧凑的元素化潜质,其明确的工作是将场景分为结构化因素。
通过分解表示,这些潜质设计是为了给模型空间,在不扭曲其他因素的情况下,对相关因素表达指示修改.

blocks.en:
Factorized Latents. Factorized latents are defined as a set of K K learnable tokens, 𝐔 ( 0 ) ∈ ℝ K × D \mathbf{U}^{(0)}\in\mathbb{R}^{K\times D} , which act as information bottlenecks to parse multimodal inputs into factorized representations.
These tokens are prepended to the [EOS] in both the query and target sequences and interact with the multimodal inputs via the MLLM’s causal attention.

Lightweight Decoder for Imagination. For target imagination, we employ a lightweight decoder parameterized by a self-attention layer and 3-layer MLP attached to an intermediate layer ℓ \ell ( ℓ = 14 \ell=14 out of 28 layers by default) of the MLLM to reconstruct the target patch representation from a vision foundation model [ 56 ] .
Note that we omit the superscript s s for brevity since the decoder is applied to each side independently.
Each 1D factorized latent u k ( ℓ ) ∈ ℝ D u^{(\ell)}_{k}\in\mathbb{R}^{D} is spatially broadcast across a 2D grid with learnable positional embeddings and passed through the decoder.
Yet, reconstructing the target from the latents alone would force them to encode the global layout of the target, which is dominated by low-frequency signals (often irrelevant to the localized edits in CIR).
Thus, we condition the decoding process on a layout prior that provides only the coarse layout of the target; ground-truth (GT) target features F ∈ ℝ H × W × D DINO F\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times D_{\textrm{DINO}}} are average-pooled to h × h h\times h , expanded back to full resolution, and added to the broadcast latents.
As this layout prior already explains the coarse layout, minimizing the reconstruction error drives the latents to carry only the information that is not contained in the coarse layout.
Consequently, for each latent k k , the decoder predicts spatial logits ℳ k ∈ ℝ H × W \mathcal{M}_{k}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W} along with reconstruction features F ^ k ∈ ℝ H × W × D DINO \hat{F}_{k}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times D_{\text{DINO}}} , where we index the H ​ W HW spatial positions by p p .
To ensure that the contributions of all latents sum to 1 at each position p p , we obtain the normalized alpha mask ℳ ¯ k \bar{\mathcal{M}}_{k} via a softmax over the latent dimension: ℳ ¯ k , p = exp ⁡ ( ℳ k , p ) ∑ k ′ = 1 K exp ⁡ ( ℳ k ′ , p ) . \bar{\mathcal{M}}_{k,p}=\frac{\exp(\mathcal{M}_{k,p})}{\sum_{k^{\prime}=1}^{K}\exp(\mathcal{M}_{k^{\prime},p})}. (1) Then, the reconstructed feature is formed by the mask-weighted sum: F ^ = ∑ k = 1 K ℳ ¯ k ⊙ F ^ k , \hat{F}=\sum\nolimits_{k=1}^{K}\bar{\mathcal{M}}_{k}\odot\hat{F}_{k}, (2) where ⊙ \odot is element-wise multiplication with broadcasting along the channel dimension.
Let F ^ q \hat{F}^{q} and F ^ t \hat{F}^{t} denote the features predicted from the query- and target-side latents, respectively.
Both are supervised against the same GT target features F F , and the imagination loss is the mean squared error averaged over both sides: ℒ imag = 1 2 ​ ∑ s ∈ { q , t } MSE ​ ( F ^ s , F ) . \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{imag}}=\frac{1}{2}\sum\nolimits_{s\in\{q,t\}}\text{MSE}(\hat{F}^{s},F). (3) As the coarse target layout prior is shared by both sides, ℒ imag \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{imag}} is minimized only by improving the residual details that are not covered by the layout prior.
On the query side, the latents must infer this residual from ( I r , T ) (I_{r},T) without observing the target, which is the component we refer to as imagination.
On the target side, the same objective anchors the target latents to the same residual factors, so that query and target latents occupy comparable factor slots for the latent matching in Sec. 3.2 .

Factor-level Matching. To explicitly involve the factorized latents in retrieval, we apply an InfoNCE [ 5 ] on top of them.
Building upon the factor alignment established by ℒ imag \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{imag}} , we define the matching score s OT ​ ( 𝐔 q , 𝐔 t ) s_{\mathrm{OT}}(\mathbf{U}^{q},\mathbf{U}^{t}) using Sinkhorn optimal transport (OT) over pairwise cosine similarities to allow flexible factor-to-factor correspondences (see Appendix E ).

Instance-level Matching. The [EOS] token, which attends to the factorized latents, aggregates the comprehended factors into a single embedding.

Propagating Factorization into the MLLM Backbone. While intermediate-layer decoding effectively encourages latent specialization, deeper layers near the retrieval output tend to lose spatial decomposition as representations abstract into global embeddings.
To preserve factorized knowledge within the MLLM backbone, we distill the spatial alpha masks ℳ ¯ \bar{\mathcal{M}} generated by the decoder into the latent-to-patch attention of the factorized latents at a deeper layer.
Note that we formulate the spatial distillation loss exclusively on the target-side forward pass, as the query-side attention maps are defined over the reference image space, which does not share a spatial grid with the target alpha masks.
Specifically, let 𝒜 k ∈ ℝ H × W \mathcal{A}_{k}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W} denote the head-averaged attention of the k k -th factorized latent toward the target patch tokens at layer ℓ top \ell_{\text{top}} , with the softmax taken over the patch keys only, bilinearly resampled to the decoder grid.
Then, we normalize 𝒜 k \mathcal{A}_{k} and ℳ ¯ k \bar{\mathcal{M}}_{k} over the spatial positions into distributions 𝐚 k \mathbf{a}_{k} and 𝐦 k \mathbf{m}_{k} , each describing the region the k k -th latent occupies: 𝐚 k , p = 𝒜 k , p ∑ p ′ 𝒜 k , p ′ , 𝐦 k , p = ℳ ¯ k , p ∑ p ′ ℳ ¯ k , p ′ . \mathbf{a}_{k,p}=\frac{\mathcal{A}_{k,p}}{\sum_{p^{\prime}}\mathcal{A}_{k,p^{\prime}}},\quad\mathbf{m}_{k,p}=\frac{\bar{\mathcal{M}}_{k,p}}{\sum_{p^{\prime}}\bar{\mathcal{M}}_{k,p^{\prime}}}. (6) Consequently, we formulate a spatial distillation loss using Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence to align the deeper layer attention distributions with the decoder’s spatial alpha masks: ℒ distill = 1 K ∑ k = 1 K KL ( 𝐦 k ∥ 𝐚 k ) . \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{distill}}=\frac{1}{K}\sum_{k=1}^{K}\mathrm{KL}\big(\mathbf{m}_{k}\,\|\,\mathbf{a}_{k}\big). (7) This explicitly transfers spatial decomposition from the decoder to the MLLM.
Although the supervision is applied only on the target side, it shapes the backbone and the latents shared by both sides, thereby encouraging the query-side latents to also retain localized semantics at inference, where the target layout prior is unavailable.

blocks.en: 3.3 Training Objective and Inference
blocks.zh: 3.3 培训目标和推断

blocks.en:
Training. Our joint objective reconciles two competing dynamics: ℒ imag \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{imag}} forces factorized latents to partition target features into disjoint factors, whereas ℒ NCE \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{NCE}} encourages latents within an instance to collapse into a single discriminative embedding [ 54 ] .
To address this, we employ a staged learning strategy.
In Stage 1, we optimize only the reconstruction loss ℒ imag \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{imag}} to warm up the factorized latents and the decoder, establishing a stable factorized prior by mapping latents to a spatially coherent region of the target scene.
In Stage 2, we further train the MLLM backbone with DoRA [ 46 ] adapters, jointly with the latents and the decoder, using full objective: ℒ total = ℒ NCE + λ imag ​ ℒ imag + λ distill ​ ℒ distill , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{total}}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{NCE}}+\lambda_{\mathrm{imag}}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{imag}}+\lambda_{\mathrm{distill}}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{distill}}, (8) where λ imag \lambda_{\mathrm{imag}} and λ distill \lambda_{\mathrm{distill}} are coefficients.
Finally, we follow ReCALL [ 76 ] to add a post-training stage which integrates MLLM-augmented triplets to reduce false negatives [ 11 , 29 ] and mitigate the influence of mislabeled triplets [ 37 , 41 , 6 ] , both of which stem from the sparse supervision of CIR datasets.
In brief, we adopt the existing augmentation pipeline to generate modification texts between each reference image and its mined hard negatives; the difference from [ 76 ] is that we condition the MLLM on the original target image and prompt it to describe what distinguishes the hard negative, which yields captions non-redundant with the original modification text in a single generation pass.
Details on the augmentation are in Appendix F .

Inference. During inference, a single forward pass yields both global embedding z z and factorized latents { u k } k = 1 K \{u_{k}\}_{k=1}^{K} .
To minimize the memory footprint and computational cost, we aggregate latents into a single mean vector u ~ = 1 K ​ ∑ k = 1 K u k \tilde{u}=\frac{1}{K}\sum_{k=1}^{K}u_{k} , and utilize it exclusively for efficient reranking.
Note that u ~ \tilde{u} is not explicitly optimized during training; rather, it serves as a compact proxy for the factorized set, whose members are aligned via OT, and thus requires no additional training.
Specifically, candidates in the gallery are initially searched with z z alone, and the top-100 candidate shortlist is reranked by integrating the cosine similarity of the mean factor as: r ⁡ ( q , t ) = cos ⁡ ( z q , z t ) + cos ⁡ ( u ~ q , u ~ t ) . r(q,t)=\cos\big({z}^{q},{z}^{t}\big)+\cos\big(\tilde{u}^{q},\tilde{u}^{t}\big). blocks.en: 4.1 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.1 主要成果

blocks.en:
In Tab. 1 , we benchmark FactEmbed on refined CIR benchmarks against recent CIR methods and general-purpose embedding models [ 25 , 52 , 43 , 35 , 63 , 45 ] using their official checkpoints.
While prior works primarily relied on broader metrics like Recall@5 on CIRR due to sample ambiguities in original benchmarks, we emphasize that Recall@1 and Subset Recall@1 on CIRR serve as more precise ranking metrics under these refined evaluation settings, where broader metrics saturate near top performance.
Specifically, FactEmbed outperforms two strong baselines, CSMCIR [ 57 ] (which additionally relies on synthetic text captions for every gallery image) and ReCALL [ 76 ] : it achieves improvements of 2.7% and 2.3% in Recall@1 on Refined-CIRR, and 2.3% and 2.4% in average Recall@10 on Refined-FashionIQ, respectively.
Notably, even when post-trained with ReCALL’s augmentation strategy, FactEmbed still surpasses prior methods (Fig. 6 ), indicating that the gains are not attributed to the augmentation alone.
These gains demonstrate the advantage of decoupling complex query understanding from direct visual alignment: our decomposed factorized latents yield fine-grained, disambiguated semantic representations that standard contrastive architectures do not explicitly encourage.
blocks.zh:
在表1中,我们参照最近采用的CIR方法和通用嵌入模式[25、52、43、35、63、45],利用官方检查站,将经过改进的CIR基准作为基准。
虽然以前的工作主要依靠更广泛的衡量标准,例如,由于原始基准的样本不明确,对CIRR的回顾@5,我们强调,对CIRR的回顾@1和Subset Recall@1,在这些经过改进的评价环境下,更广泛的衡量标准在接近最高性能的情况下,是更精确的排名衡量标准。
具体地说,FactEmbed超越了两个强基线,CSMCIR[57](每个画廊图像还依赖于合成文本标题)和ReCALL[76]:在Recall@1 on Refined-CIRR中,它分别实现了2.7%和2.3%的改进,在Recalled-FashionIQ上,平均2.3%和2.4%的改进.
值得注意的是,即使经过后期培训并采用RECALL的扩充战略,FactEmbed仍然超越了先前的方法(图6),表明收益并非仅归因于扩充。
这些成果表明,将复杂的查询理解与直接的视觉对齐脱钩是有好处的:我们被分解的因子化的潜质产生精细、模糊的语义表述,标准对比性架构没有明确鼓励这种表述。

blocks.en:
In Tab. 3 and Tab. 3 , we further report performance on the original CIRR and FashionIQ datasets.
Notably, all methods score substantially lower on the original benchmarks than on their refined counterparts.
Excluding Qwen3-VL-Embedding 8B, this gap reaches at most 13.7 points in R@1 on CIRR and 15.6 points in average R@10 on FashionIQ, whereas Qwen3-VL-Embedding 8B, the state-of-the-art generalist model, exhibits the largest gap (15.1 and 16.7 points, respectively).
This is consistent with prior findings [ 18 , 47 ] that the original benchmarks contain ambiguous annotations and evaluation artifacts, which may underestimate the compositional reasoning capabilities of high-capacity models.
Nevertheless, FactEmbed achieves the best overall result.

值得注意的是,所有方法在原始基准上的得分都大大低于经过完善的对应方法。
除Qwen3-VL-Embedding 8B外,这一差距在CIRR的R@1和FashionIQ的平均R@10的15.6点达到最高13.7点,而最新通论模式Qwen3-VL-Embedding 8B则表现出最大的差距(分别为15.1和16.7点).
这与先前的结论[18,47]一致,即原始基准中包含模棱两可的说明和评价文物,可能低估了高容量模型的构成推理能力.
尽管如此,FactEmbed还是取得了最佳的总体成果.

blocks.en: 4.2 Forming Embeddings with Factorized Latents
blocks.zh: 4.2 用因数化的底线形成嵌入物

blocks.en:
As factorized latents can be turned into a retrieval score in several ways, we compare the variants in Tab. 4 .
Matching the full latent set via OT (“Full Factor”) achieves the highest R@1 on both benchmarks, but requires storing K K vectors per gallery image, whose storage and search costs grow with the gallery size [ 27 , 9 ] .
Among single-vector alternatives, the mean-pooled latents (“Mean Factor”) [ 45 ] perform the worst, as u ~ \tilde{u} is never directly optimized for retrieval, leaving u ~ \tilde{u} less discriminative as a standalone global embedding.
Yet, directly optimizing u ~ \tilde{u} with the instance-level objective in place of [EOS] (“Mean Factor # ”) still falls behind [EOS] in R@1 on both benchmarks, suggesting that imposing instance-level objective on the latents pulls them toward a single discriminative embedding at the cost of fine-grained evidence.
We therefore keep the latents factor-aligned and use [EOS] as the global embedding for initial retrieval, while exploiting u ~ \tilde{u} as complementary factor-level evidence for reranking.
This efficient reranking narrows the R@1 gap to Full Factor to 0.24 and 0.21, with only two vectors per gallery image, a memory footprint on par with standard multi-vector CIR methods [ 41 , 37 , 67 , 29 , 2 ] .
blocks.zh:
由于因子化的潜质可以通过多种方式转化为检索分数,我们比较了Tab中的变体. 4 (英语).
通过OT( " Full Factor " )匹配完整的潜伏集可以实现两个基准中最高的R@1,但需要存储每个画廊图像的K K矢量,其存储和搜索成本随着画廊的大小而增加[27,9].
在单一媒介替代品中,平均集合的潜伏物(“元因子”)[45]表现最差,因为u ~\tilde{u}从未被直接优化用于检索,留下u ~\tilde{u}作为独立的全球嵌入物,其歧视性较低。
然而,直接优化 u ~\tilde{u} 取代 [EOS] (“ Mean factor # ”) 的 实例级目标在两个基准上仍然落后于 R@1 中的 [EOS] , 这表明将实例级目标强加于潜在者, 将它们推向一个单一的歧视性嵌入, 而牺牲了精细的证据。
因此,我们保持潜在因子对齐并使用[EOS]作为初始检索的全球嵌入,同时利用u~\tilde{u}作为补充因子级证据,重新排位。
这种高效的重新排序将R@1的缺口缩小为全因子0.24和0.21,每个画廊图像只有两个向量,一个内存足迹与标准的多向量 CIR 方法相当 [41, 37, 67, 29, 2].

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.3 发育研究

blocks.en:
In Tab. 5 , we conduct component ablation study.
Introducing factorized latents with the target imagination alone (b) does not consistently improve retrieval: while it improves R@10 on FashionIQ and Refined-FashionIQ by 1.00 and 1.16, and R@5 on CIRR by 0.99, it slightly lowers R@1 on CIRR.
We attribute this to the gap between generation and discrimination: target reconstruction structures the latents into semantically factorized components, which already benefits FashionIQ where modifications are confined to localized attributes, but it provides no explicit alignment metric for ranking, so the decomposition alone is insufficient for precise top-1 retrieval on open-domain CIRR.
Yet, as it lays a robust foundation for fine-grained query decomposition, we find that bridging the gap with factor-level InfoNCE (c) and incorporating the attention distillation loss (e) effectively enhances the retrieval performance by transferring localized decomposition into the MLLM’s deeper attention layer.
Subsequently, incorporating our ERR in (f) delivers a prominent gain of 1.17 and 0.97 in Avg. on CIRR and Refined-CIRR, respectively. In contrast, applying the same reranking to latents trained without any auxiliary objective changes Avg. by only − 0.37 -0.37 and + 0.24 +0.24 , indicating that the gain does not stem from merely fusing an additional vector but from the structure imposed by our objectives.
We note that this gain comes at a marginal computational overhead, as the factorized latents are generated within the same forward pass (see Appendix C ).
Lastly, integrating the post-training stage (h) achieves additional gains, demonstrating the effectiveness of mitigating the noise arising from the sparse supervision of CIR datasets.
To verify that these gains are not attributed to the augmentation alone, we also apply the post-training stage directly to the baseline (g).
While post-training alone improves the baseline, our full model (h) further surpasses it by 2.91 and 2.57 in R@1 on CIRR and Refined-CIRR, and by 2.87 and 2.37 in R@10 on FashionIQ and Refined-FashionIQ, respectively.
Moreover, the gains of our components remain comparable with and without post-training ((a) → \rightarrow (f) vs. (g) → \rightarrow (h)), indicating that our framework and the augmentation are complementary.
blocks.zh:
在Tab. 5中,我们进行部分衰减研究。
仅仅用目标想象力引入因素化的潜质(b)并不能持续改善检索:虽然它在时尚IQ和精炼-时尚IQ上改进了R@10,在CIRR上改进了1.00和1.16,在CIRR上改进了R@5,在CIRR上则降低了R@1.
我们将此归因于世代与歧视之间的差距:目标重建结构,其潜伏因素已形成成因子化的组件,这已经使FashionIQ受益,因为修改仅限于局部属性,但它没有为排名提供明确的对齐度量,因此单是分解不足以在开放域的CIRR上精确的顶部-1检索.
然而,由于它为精细分解查询打下了坚实的基础,我们发现缩小与系数级InfoncE(c)的差距,并纳入注意力分解损失(e),通过将局部分解转移到MLLM更深的注意力层,有效地提高了检索性能。
随后,将我们的ERR纳入(f),在Avg.中分别得出关于CIRR和Refined-CIRR的1.17和0.97的显著收益。 与此相对照,对训练出来的没有辅助目标变化的潜伏物进行同样的重新排位,Avg只增加了− 0.37-0.37和+ 0.24+0.24 ,表明收益并非仅仅来自引信额外载体,而是来自我们的目标所强加的结构。
我们注意到,这一收益来自边际的计算间接费用,因为因素化的潜伏是在同一前进通道内产生的(见附录C)。
最后,整合培训后阶段(h)可取得更多成果,表明有效减轻由于对中央应急反应中心数据集的监督不足而产生的噪音。
为了核实这些收益并非仅归因于扩充,我们还直接将培训后阶段应用于基线(g)。
虽然仅培训后就改善了基线,但我们的完整模式(h)在CIRR和Refined-CIRR的R@1和在FashionIQ和Refined-FashionIQ的R@10的2.87和2.37中分别进一步超过了2.91和2.57。
此外,我们各组成部分的收益与培训后((a) + rightarrow(f) → (g) → rightarrow(h))相仿,表明我们的框架和扩充是相辅相成的。

blocks.en: 4.4 Analysis and Discussion
blocks.zh: 4.4 分析和讨论

blocks.en:
Imagination Layer Selection. Determining the MLLM layer ℓ \ell for target imagination governs a trade-off; when the decoder is attached too early, the factorized latents may lack sufficient contextual fusion of multimodal inputs to imagine the target, while attaching it too late leaves insufficient subsequent layers to transform the decomposed factors into a discriminative retrieval embedding.
In Fig. 2(a) , we evaluate decoder placements at layers ℓ ∈ { 7 , 14 , 21 } \ell\in\{7,14,21\} of the 28-layer MLLM, and find that ℓ = 14 \ell=14 yields the best result, which aligns with recent findings [ 24 , 77 ] .

在图2(a)中,我们评价28层MLLM中的解码器放置层1 {{ 7, 14, 21}\ell\ in 7, 14, 21},发现l = 14\ ell= 14 得出最佳结果,符合最近的调查结果[24, 77]。

Impact of Target Imagination. To isolate the effect of target imagination, we compare against variants that train the latents solely with InfoNCE, matched by either maximum similarity (MS) [ 75 ] or OT, in Fig. 2(b) .
While these variants outperform the naïve baseline, we observe that target imagination brings a further gain by enforcing the latents to decompose and structure the target scene rather than relying on the contrastive signal alone.
Also, OT matching consistently outperforms MS matching strategy on both benchmarks, supporting our choice of OT for factor-level matching.

Fig. 4 visualizes the decomposition under different prior resolutions.
Without the layout prior, the latents must also encode the global layout, which dominates the reconstruction objective and causes them to collapse into a few coarse regions.
In contrast, when the prior is injected, we found that the factorized latents are encouraged to focus on fine-grained visual structures, decomposing the target into localized parts such as arms, legs, and necklines.
We set h = 2 h=2 so that the layout prior provides only the coarse layout while leaving the localized factors to the latents.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we present FactEmbed, a framework that better exploits the MLLM’s compositional understanding capability to simulate visual edits by decoupling compositional query comprehension from learning discriminative embedding.
To structure query comprehension, we prepend factorized latents that act as an information bottleneck, trained to imagine the residual target factors beyond a coarse layout prior that groups semantically coherent visual factors of the target without dense annotations.
We then bridge generative imagination and discriminative retrieval by optimizing a factor-level InfoNCE loss via optimal transport and distilling the decoder’s alpha masks into the MLLM’s deeper attention maps.
At inference, the [EOS] token serves as a global-level embedding to perform initial retrieval, while the mean-pooled factorized latents, produced in the same forward pass, rerank a short candidate list at negligible cost.
Extensive evaluations show that FactEmbed achieves state-of-the-art performance, suggesting that factor-level supervision on top of instance-level matching improves MLLM-based CIR.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们介绍了FactEmbed,这个框架可以更好地利用MLLM的构成理解能力,通过将构成的查询理解与学习歧视性嵌入来模拟视觉编辑。
为了在结构上理解查询,我们预先将一些潜在因素作为信息瓶颈,经过培训后,可以想象出超出粗糙布局的剩余目标因素,然后将目标整体上一致的视觉因素组合在一起,而不作密集的说明。
然后我们通过最佳运输优化因子级的InfoNCE损失,将解码器的α面罩分馏到MLLM的更深层关注图中,从而将基因想象和区别性检索联系起来。
推论,[EOS]标志是全球层面的嵌入物,用于进行初步检索,而在同一前方通行证中产生的平均集合因素化潜伏物则以可忽略不计的成本重新排入简短的候选人名单。
广泛的评价表明FactEmbed达到了最先进的性能,建议在实例级匹配之上的系数级监督可以改进基于MLLM的CIR.

blocks.en:
Limitations. Despite its effectiveness, FactEmbed has several limitations.
First, using a fixed K K ignores the input complexity since no explicit supervision specifies the number of semantic factors.
Exploring query-adaptive latents and matching schemes across varying set sizes remains for future work.
Second, while full-factor retrieval achieves higher accuracy, we mean-pool the latents for efficient reranking, unexploiting part of the fine-grained information.
Incorporating Matryoshka representation learning [ 28 ] into factor representations may preserve accuracy of full-factor matching near single-vector storage costs.
Lastly, our evaluation is limited to CIRR and FashionIQ; thus, generalizability as a unified multimodal retriever requires further verification.

blocks.en:
To analyze whether each factorized latent specializes in distinct concepts, we examine the cosine similarity between factorized latents both within the same instance and across different instances (Tab. 7 ).
Specifically, we compare our approach against two baseline variants: one where learnable latents are prepended to the [EOS] token without additional constraints, and another where the factor-level InfoNCE objective is introduced.
blocks.zh:
为了分析每个因素化的潜伏是否都专门涉及不同的概念,我们审查了同一情况下和不同情况下因素化的潜伏的同位素相似性(第7段)。
具体地说,我们将我们的方法与两个基线变量进行比较:一个是可以学习的潜伏物准备到[EOS]标志上,没有额外的限制;另一个是引入系数级的InfoncE目标。

blocks.en:
As discussed in Sec. 3.3 , applying the factor-level InfoNCE alone without the imagination objective ℒ imag \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{imag}} (b) increases the similarity among latents within each instance, causing them to collapse into a single instance-level representation.
This is because the retrieval objective only requires the latents to be collectively discriminative across instances, providing no incentive for individual latents to take on distinct roles.
Furthermore, this representation collapse becomes even more pronounced when the per-latent mean vector (computed across the dataset) is subtracted from each latent, indicating that the latents share instance-specific rather than factor-specific information.
In contrast, incorporating our imagination and distillation objectives (c) yields the lowest within-instance similarity, with a clear margin after removing the per-latent mean (0.548 vs. 0.599 and 0.841).
This indicates that our framework encourages the latents to take on distinct roles, whereas naïvely employing multi-vector latents with a retrieval objective drives them toward a shared representation.
blocks.zh:
如第3.3节所述,仅在没有想象目标L imag\mathcal{L}_{\ mathrm{imag}}(b)的情况下适用系数级的InfoncE,增加了每个实例内潜伏者的相似性,导致它们崩溃为单一实例级代表。
这是因为,检索目标只要求潜在因素在各种情况下具有集体歧视性,不鼓励个人潜在因素发挥不同的作用。
此外,如果从每个潜在数据中减去相对相对平均矢量(从数据集中得出),表明潜在数据共享特定实例而不是特定要素的信息,这种表示崩溃就更加明显。
与此相对照,纳入我们的想象力和提炼目标(c) 产生最小的内在相似性,在去除相对比值(0.548对0.599和0.841)后,有明显的比值。
这表明,我们的框架鼓励潜伏者发挥不同的作用,而天真地利用具有回收目标的多行动者潜伏者则促使他们实现共同的代表。

blocks.en:
Note that the latents without any auxiliary objective (a) also exhibit low within-instance similarity.
We attribute this phenomenon to the fact that the latents are orthogonally initialized and largely retain this initial bias due to the lack of direct supervision.
Indeed, these latents do not benefit retrieval: even with efficient reranking, they achieve an average of 73.21 on Refined-CIRR and 79.60 on the CIRR test set, falling below the baseline without latents (74.65 and 79.80), where the averages follow Tab. 1 and Tab. 3 , i.e . , (R@1 + R subset {}_{\text{subset}} @1)/2 and (R@5 + R subset {}_{\text{subset}} @1)/2, respectively.
In contrast, under the same setting without post-training, our latents raise these scores to 76.05 and 82.35 (Tab. 5 (f)), confirming that they are not only distinct but also informative for retrieval.

blocks.en: Appendix C Inference Cost
blocks.zh: 附录C 推论 费用

blocks.en:
A natural concern with multi-vector representations is that they trade retrieval quality for memory footprint and query latency [ 27 , 75 ] .
To address this, Tab. 8 quantifies the inference overhead on the CIRR validation set (2,297 gallery images) using a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell GPU.
Crucially, the forward pass of the query encoder dominates the end-to-end latency pipeline, requiring 353ms per query at batch size 1 and an average of 164ms per query at batch size 32.
In contrast, scoring the gallery using only the [EOS] embedding requires only 0.06ms per query.
Our efficient reranking procedure, which re-scores the top-100 shortlist with the sum of the cosine similarities from each [EOS] and mean factorized vector, adds one extra vector per image to the index and 0.17ms per query at batch size 1 (0.003ms amortized), which only induces less than 0.05% overhead on the total latency.
We adopt this design as our default inference configuration, as its storage footprint remains comparable to, or slightly smaller than that of recent CIR methods that maintain multi-vector galleries [ 41 , 37 , 67 , 29 , 23 , 2 ] .
When storage and compute budgets permit, however, the full latent variant can be preferred, as full OT matching offers slightly higher R@1 (Tab. 4 ).
Note that its time overhead remains marginal at the scale of the CIRR validation gallery, but both its storage ( K K vectors per image) and its scoring cost grow linearly with the gallery size, whereas efficient reranking only rescores a fixed top-100 shortlist.

为了解决这一问题,Tab. 8用一个单一的NVIDIA RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell GPU对CIRR验证集(2,297幅画廊图像)的推论管理费进行了量化。
关键的是,查询编码器的前传主导了端到端的延时管道,每查询需要353ms的批号1,每查询平均需要164ms的批号32.
相比之下,只使用[EOS]嵌入的画廊评分每一次查询只需0.06ms.
我们高效的重新排序程序,将前100名短名单与每个[EOS]的余弦相似度和平均因子化矢量的总和重排,在索引中每个图像增加一个额外的矢量,在批量尺寸1(0.03ms摊销)时每个查询增加0.17ms,这只会诱导总延迟率低于0.05%的间接费用.
我们采用这一设计作为我们的默认推论配置,因为其存储足迹仍然与最近维持多载体画廊的CIR方法相当或略小[41、37、67、29、23、2]。

blocks.en: Appendix D Additional Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录D 其他执行细节

blocks.en:
In this section, we elaborate additional implementation details.
While we use base learning rates of 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} and 4 × 10 − 5 4\times 10^{-5} to train DoRA modules attached to the pretrained backbone parameters for CIRR and Fashion-IQ, respectively, we apply 4 × 10 − 4 4\times 10^{-4} as the learning rate to modules such as the factorized latent and imagination decoder since our newly introduced components are trained from scratch.
For the training schedule, we use 3,000, 500, and 350 steps across the three stages for CIRR, and 3,000, 350, and 350 steps for FashionIQ.
While Stage 1 could technically be trained jointly with the later stages, the competing dynamics between ℒ imag \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{imag}} and ℒ NCE \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{NCE}} slow down the formation of factorized latents, requiring substantially longer training to converge.
Isolating Stage 1 to train only the decoder and the latents with ℒ imag \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{imag}} removes this competition and further allows bypassing the upper layers of the MLLM backbone, yielding a substantially more compute-efficient setup: Stage 1 completes in approximately 13 hours on 4 × \times RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell GPUs.
Then, subsequent training stages were conducted using 2 × \times RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs using PyTorch FSDP.
Images are resized within the processor to between 3,136 3{,}136 and 147,456 147{,}456 pixels, with input sequences truncated at 512 512 tokens.

blocks.en: Appendix F Post-training with MLLM Augmentation
blocks.zh: 附录F 与 MLLM 增强有关的培训后

blocks.en:
A typical challenge in CIR is that the modification text often underdetermines the target image.
In other words, instructions are often rarely exhaustive; they specify what should change while leaving everything else implicit.
Consequently, a single composed query can often be satisfied by multiple candidate images in the gallery.
To address this, prior works have leveraged LLM/MLLMs to sharpen the query itself to disambiguate the instruction [ 67 , 11 ] , enlarged the clean paired triplets [ 78 , 80 , 18 , 76 ] .
Similarly, we follow ReCALL [ 76 ] to augment training triplets by pairing each reference image with its mined hard negative instances, and then finetune the model on the resulting data (comprising the reference image, its hard negative, and a generated modification text).
Operating on FactEmbed after Stage 2, our augmentation pipeline consists of two phases: hard negative mining and contrastive captioning.
During the mining phase, we follow ReCALL to extract hard negative instances I h I_{h} for each reference image I r I_{r} that ranks above the ground truth I t I_{t} , which are then passed to the contrastive captioning phase.

换言之,指示往往很少详尽无遗;说明应该改变什么,而忽略其他一切。
因此,一个单一的由人组成的查询往往可以通过画廊中的多个候选图像来满足.
为了解决这一问题,先前的工程利用LLM/MLLM使询问本身更加清晰,使指令 [67,11] ,扩大了干净的配对三胞胎 [78, 80, 18, 76].
同样,我们遵循ReCALL[76],通过将每个参考图像与所挖掘的硬负数配对来增强培训三进制,然后根据由此产生的数据对模型进行微调(包括参考图像、硬负数和生成的修改文本)。

We thus streamline the pipeline with two modifications, while keeping the remaining instructions of ReCALL’s captioning prompt unchanged.
First, we employ contrastive captioning strategy, which additionally presents the original target I t I_{t} alongside I r I_{r} and I h I_{h} , and instruct the model to describe I h I_{h} such that the text no longer applies to I t I_{t} .
Note that I t I_{t} serves purely as a conditioning signal and is omitted from the augmented triplet.
Second, we replace the local captioner with GPT-5.6-luna [ 55 ] via the batch API, which can follow both the contrast instruction and the output format in a single pass, removing the retry loop and separate verification stage.
blocks.zh:
因此,经过两次修改后,我们精简了管道,同时保持ReCALL标题的其余指示不变。
首先,我们采用了对比性的标题策略,该策略还提出了I r I r 和 I h I r 的原始目标,并指示模型描述I h I r h ,使文本不再适用于I t I_{t 。
请注意,我t i_{t} 纯粹是一个调节信号 并且被省略 从增加的三胞胎。
其次,我们通过批量API将本地字幕替换为GPT-5.6-luna[55],它既可以遵循对比指令,也可以遵循输出格式,单传,去掉重试循环和单独的验证阶段.

blocks.en:
Compared with the ReCALL’s two-image prompting strategy on 100 sampled mined queries per dataset, we found that our contrastive captioning successfully yields an edited modification text while the two-image prompting strategy produced 27.0% (CIRR) and 33.0% (FashionIQ) of modification texts unchanged.
Furthermore, among the edited queries, we found that 30.1% (CIRR) and 10.5% (FashionIQ) of the modification texts rewritten by the two-image prompting strategy were judged by GPT-5.6-luna to describe the original target I t I_{t} better than the mined target I h I_{h} , while our contrastive captioning reduced this reversal rate to 7.0% and 0.0%, respectively.
Consequently, as shown in Fig. 6 , our contrastive captioning yields larger gains than the augmentation strategy of ReCALL on most metrics, with comparable results on R s @1 of Refined-CIRR.
This demonstrates that our streamlined pipeline is not only more efficient, as it requires neither a caption retry loop nor a separate verification stage, but also yields higher-quality augmentation.
We remark that other than these modifications, we followed ReCALL [ 76 ] to mine five hard negatives per composed query, resulting in 57,476 (CIRR) and 56,499 (FashionIQ) captioning requests.
This incurs a one-time cost of only $22.82 (CIRR) and $26.17 (FashionIQ), which is highly economical compared to renting GPU servers to deploy a local MLLM, which often struggles with strict output formatting and thus requires repeated retries.

blocks.en: F.2 Hard Negative Filtering
blocks.zh: F.2 硬负过滤

blocks.en:
Hard negative mining occasionally yields near-duplicate instances that are virtually identical to the annotated target despite holding distinct identifiers in the same dataset.
Rewriting such a pair forces the model to generate text that separates two near-identical images, teaching the retriever to incorrectly push them apart.
To prevent this, we filter out these pairs prior to contrastive captioning based on visual feature similarity via DINOv2 [ 56 ] before we query the MLLM to write the captions.
Specifically, we encoded each image using a frozen DINOv2 ViT-B/14 backbone and mean-pooled the patch tokens into a single descriptor, discarding hard negative candidates ( I h I_{h} ) that exhibit a cosine similarity exceeding 0.99 0.99 with the original target ( I t I_{t} ).
This filtering step removes 743 743 CIRR instances and 277 277 FashionIQ instances out of 58,219 58,219 and 56,776 56,776 mined pairs, respectively.
For Stage 3, we additionally filter mislabeled original triplets: when mining with the Stage 2 model, we also record the rank of the ground-truth target, and drop the 3% of original triplets whose ground truth is ranked lowest.
blocks.zh:
硬负开采偶尔会产生与附加说明的目标几乎相同的近似重复的情况,尽管在同一数据集中持有不同的标识符。
重写这样一对迫使模型生成将两个近似图像分开的文本,教检索器错误地将它们分开.
为了防止这种情况,我们在通过DINOv2[56]查询MLLM以写入标题之前,先根据视觉特征的相似性过滤出这些配对.
具体地说,我们用一个冷冻的DINOv2 VIT-B/14主干线对每个图像进行编码,并将补丁符号平均拼凑成一个单一的描述符,丢弃了显示余弦相似度超过0.99 0.99的硬负候选人(Ih I_{h}),与原目标(I t I_{t}).
在58 219个58 219个和56 776个5 676个地雷对中,这一过滤步骤分别消除了743 743个CIRR和277个时尚IQ。
对于第3阶段,我们额外过滤错误标签的原始三胞胎:在使用第2阶段模式开采时,我们也记录了地面真相目标的级别,并降低了地面真相排名最低的3%的原始三胞胎。

blocks.en:
Finally, for the post-training stage, we optimize our model using the total objective, described in Eq. 8 , similarly to stage 2.
Note that we construct each batch for CIRR by grouping an original triplet with its MLLM-augmented counterparts following [ 76 ] .
This strategy supplies high-quality in-batch hard negatives, explicitly encouraging the model to discern subtle visual differences.

最后,对于培训后阶段,我们利用Eq.8所述的总目标优化模式,类似于第2阶段。
请注意,我们为CIRR建造每批货物,在[76]之后,将原来的三胞胎与经MLLM加固的对应物组合在一起。
这一策略提供了高质量的插座硬底片,明确鼓励模型识别微妙的视觉差异.

blocks.en: F.4 Limitation of Contrastive Captioning
blocks.zh: F.4 限制矛盾说明

blocks.en:
While our contrastive captioning mitigates noisy supervision in both the original and augmented triplets, a limitation remains when scaling up the augmentation.
Contrastive captioning conditions each rewrite only on the original target I t I_{t} , so it reduces ambiguity between I t I_{t} and a hard negative but not among the multiple hard negatives mined for the same composed query.
As more hard negatives are mined per query, i.e., each pair of reference image I r I_{r} and modification text T T , we expect these sibling hard negatives to increasingly overlap in semantics, so that a modification text written for one may equally describe another, introducing false negatives within the augmented set.
An effective augmentation strategy for CIR therefore requires conditioning across both the original and augmented sets, so that each generated instruction captures features that distinguish its target from all other candidates of the same query.
Nevertheless, since the augmented triplets consistently improve CIR performance in our experiments, we will publicly release them to facilitate future research.
blocks.zh:
虽然我们对比性的标题减轻了原有的和增加的三胞胎的吵闹监督,但在扩大增加时仍存在限制。
对比性字幕条件只重写在 I t I_{t} 上, 从而减少 I t I_{t} 和 硬底片之间的模糊性, 但不在为相同编组的查询而挖掘的多个硬底片中 。
由于每个查询都挖掘出更多的硬底片,即每对参考图像I r I_{r}和修改文本T T,我们期望这些双胞胎硬底片在语义学上会越来越重叠,因此,为一个人写的修改文本可以同样描述另一个,在扩展集中引入假底片.
因此,CIR的有效扩增战略要求在原有和扩增的组合中都加以调整,使每个生成的指令能够捕捉到其目标与同一查询中所有其他候选人的特征。
然而,由于增加的三胞胎在我们的实验中不断提高CIR的性能,我们将公开释放它们以促进未来的研究。

blocks.en: Appendix G Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 附录G 定性 结果

blocks.en:
In Fig. 7 , Fig. 8 , Fig. 9 , and Fig. 10 , we present qualitative comparisons between FactEmbed and our baseline (Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct [ 1 ] fine-tuned via DoRA [ 46 ] ).
In CIR, modifying a reference image with text often projects the query into a broad semantic space where multiple target images can be considered valid matches.
Therefore, rather than restricting our analysis to Top-1 prediction, we examine the Top-8 retrieved results to better assess the overall alignment between the composed query and the retrieved distribution.
blocks.zh:
在图7、图8、图9和图10中,我们提出了FactEmbed与基线之间的定性比较(Quen2.5-VL-7B-通过DoRA[46]微调)。
在CIR中,用文本修改一个参考图像往往将查询投射到一个宽语义空间,其中多个目标图像可以被认为是有效的匹配.
因此,我们审查Top-8检索结果,而不是仅限于Top-1预测,以更好地评估所组成的查询与检索分布之间的总体一致性。

blocks.en:
In the first example of Fig. 7 , which belongs to the dress category of FashionIQ dataset, the query specifies an item that is “more fashionable and party wear and is cream and brown with animal print”.
While both models successfully capture the desired color scheme, FactEmbed ranks candidates that accurately reflect the fine-grained “animal print” pattern higher than the baseline.
In the second example, the baseline struggles with structural modifications, incorrectly retrieving an item with short sleeves at Rank-2 and entirely ignoring the requested “strap” detail at Rank-3.
Conversely, FactEmbed strictly adheres to these fine-grained structural constraints across the top ranked candidates.
Fig. 8 further highlights a common failure mode in standard contrastive learning, which fails to handle negative constraints.
For the query containing the phrase “instead of superman logo”, the baseline fails to disentangle the negated element, retrieving images containing the superman logo.
In contrast, FactEmbed successfully suppresses the negated visual element while maintaining the core semantics of the reference image.
blocks.zh:
在属于FashionIQ数据集服装类别的Fig. 7的第一个例子中,查询中指定了一个“更时髦和派对穿戴、奶油和棕色带有动物印记”的项目。
虽然这两个模型都成功地捕捉到理想的配色方案,但FactEmbed对候选人进行了排名,准确反映了比基线更高的精细“动物印刷”模式。
在第二个例子中,基线与结构改变相冲突,错误地收回了Rank-2的短袖子,完全无视Rank-3要求的“陷阱”细节。
反之,FactEmbed在排名最高的候选人中严格遵守这些精细的结构限制。
图8进一步突出了标准对比性学习中常见的失败模式,它未能处理消极的制约.
对于包含“而不是超人标志”的查询,基线未能将否定的元素分割开来,检索包含超人标志的图像。
相比之下,FactEmbed成功地压制了被否定的视觉元素,同时保持了参考图像的核心语义.

blocks.en:
This gap in multimodal understanding extends to the open-domain CIRR dataset.
As shown in the first example of Fig. 10 , the query requires the model to identify “map displayed on the screen” of a smartphone.
While the baseline is easily distracted by generic smartphone images, FactEmbed accurately grounds the text modification into the precise visual context.
Also, for queries involving relative counting or relational reasoning (e.g., second example), the baseline exhibits a severe lack of compositional understanding.
Overall, we find that the baseline trained with standard contrastive learning often ignores the comparative conditions, while FactEmbed captures these relationships more faithfully.
blocks.zh:
多式联运理解方面的这一差距延伸到开放域CIRR数据集。
如图10的第一例所示,查询要求模型识别智能手机“显示在屏幕上的地图”。
虽然基线很容易被通用智能手机图像分散注意力,但FactEmbed准确地将文本修改作为精确视觉上下文的依据.
另外,对于涉及相对计数或关系推理的询问(例如第二例),基线显示严重缺乏对构成的理解。
总体而言,我们发现,通过标准对比性学习而训练的基线往往忽略了比较条件,而FactEmbed更忠实地抓住了这些关系.
